description.value: Ono Poké is a Victoria-based Hawaiian poké bar with four shopping-centre locations across the city, founded by a restaurateur who discovered traditional Hawaiian poké on a trip to the islands and set out to recreate that experience on the West Coast. The menu centres on customizable ahi tuna bowls marinated in house shoyu blends, alongside Hawaiian hot plates like Loco Moco and Garlic Shrimp. It's a fast-casual, build-your-own concept with a broad range of dietary accommodations, making it a practical and flavourful refuelling stop for cyclists passing through Victoria's commercial centres.

bike_parking_detail: 5 racks within 100m: rack at 33m; rack at 44m; rack at 51m; rack at 55m; floor (covered) at 61m.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website (onopoke.ca) is fully accessible and confirms an active, multi-location Hawaiian poké restaurant chain in Victoria with four shopping-centre locations. The website never uses the name 'Ono Poké & Grill' — it consistently refers to the business as 'Ono Poke Bar' or simply 'Ono Poké', which is flagged as a concern. Takeout and Uber Eats ordering are confirmed by the website; vegan, gluten-free, and keto options are explicitly listed; no bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or charging amenities are mentioned anywhere in the website content.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM records the business as 'Ono Poké & Grill' but the website consistently uses 'Ono Poke Bar' or 'Ono Poké' — the '& Grill' suffix does not appear anywhere on the site.
